about_short_description.short_description: Inai allows vendors to set up their payment stack with a single integration.

product.name: Orchestrate
product.description: A payment orchestration platform that connects merchants with payment vendors and local payment methods through a single integration, supporting pay-ins, pay-outs, localized checkout, and transaction routing.

product.name: Observe
product.description: A payment analytics and observability product that provides transaction data, payment-stack analytics, and AI-based recommendations to identify authorization, performance, and cost opportunities.

product.name: Reconcile
product.description: A payment reconciliation and fee-analysis product that consolidates transaction data from payment processors, identifies discrepancies, and provides detailed visibility into payment fees.

product.name: Revive
product.description: A failed-payment recovery service that uses automated, machine-learning-driven retry strategies to recover revenue, reduce involuntary churn, and improve retention for recurring and digital businesses.

product.name: Alerts
product.description: A payment monitoring product that tracks payment metrics in real time, detects anomalies, and notifies teams so they can investigate and respond to performance issues.
